description.value: Craft 42 Roasters is a specialty coffee roaster and café in Kelowna that sources competition-level, single-origin beans from Colombia, Ethiopia, Guatemala, and Honduras through Canadian importers with an emphasis on fair wages and sustainable packaging. The name references the childhood home address of the founder, and the business carries those family values — compassion, respect, and education — into every aspect of sourcing and roasting. Cyclists stopping in can also book a guided coffee tasting experience or browse brewing gear alongside their café visit.

The OSM phone (+1 289-339-4020) matches the contact-information subpage ('Phone number: 2893394020'), but the site footer consistently shows a different number '(250)878-3186' across all pages — this discrepancy is flagged.
